mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_user_consent (user_id, consent_type, is_required, terms_version, status, withdrawn_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{consentType}, #{required}, #{termsVersion}, #{status}, #{withdrawnAt}, #{expiresAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_required = #{required}, terms_version = #{termsVersion}, status = #{status}, withdrawn_at = #{withdrawnAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}
mapper.select: SELECT consent_type AS consentType, is_required AS required, terms_version AS termsVersion, status, withdrawn_at AS withdrawnAt, expires_at AS expiresAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM tbl_user_consent WHERE user_id = #{userId}
